Hi Maya / Tom / Ellen —

Quick background: BluePeak is evaluating a clandestine data-enrichment pipeline and wants to move from PoC to a pilot. Expected first-year ARR if pilot converts is ~USD 420k and they have strict network/compliance requirements (VPC, restricted S3 access). We've captured the discovery notes in the attached intake form and flagged the security and marketplace timelines.

Ask: can Redwood be registered for ACE co-sell for this opportunity and can you introduce a PDM/PSM who can join a short handshake? We'd like to align on the following items in the call:
- ACE registration checklist and estimated time-to-listing
- PDM/PSM coverage model and who owns which deliverables
- Any marketplace packaging constraints that affect trial pricing

Proposed times (PDT): Mon 7/24 10–11am, Tue 7/25 8–9am, Wed 7/26 2–3pm. If none of these work, propose alternatives.

Attachments: bluepeak-intake-form.pdf (intake + topline ARR estimate)
